ai_review.review: Both fans highlight the high‑energy vibe of this early‑'80s performance, calling it a "shakedown" that really fires up. The recording itself is praised as an excellent capture, with no technical complaints noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Two positive reviews (5 and 4 stars) emphasize strong show energy and a solid capture; limited sample size reduces confidence.
